title: Fixed Triangular-Frame Drag Harrow
description: One complete newly authored stationary triangular drag-harrow appearance: a thick closed triangular timber perimeter surrounds a true triangular opening; two full crossbars span it, with six separately editable backward-raked blunt ground teeth distributed beneath those bars. A forward integral-form draw tongue joins a true open terminal ring. The wide low frame carries distributed downward teeth, unlike a single long hand shaft and fork shoulder, a longitudinal mouldboard plough with curling share or a transverse two-neck yoke. Eleven closed editable meshes and three constant opaque PBR roles; one prop and zero scenes. Six real finite blunt tip faces define the static ground datum. No actual draft linkage, soil cultivation, tooth strength, motion, force, animal/tractor fit, manufacturing or safety claim.
